source_reference: 10_PLAN_COMMAND_WIRING_DRY_IMPACT.md (DRY component families). Names are candidate design roles, not final component IDs; audit agent adjudicates exact canonical names.
principle: Stream exercises the shared DRY grammar so that C4 managers (Storage, Backup, Lifecycle, History, Runtime Artifacts, Source Control, GitHub Actions, Containers, Web, Search Index, Cleanup) reuse the same shells/rows/health/observable/receipt components as core and as sibling-owned families. No C4 family introduces a bespoke component when a shared role fits.

components.role: Deep-link target resolver. Maps 'Open setting: {id}' / category / landmark ids to a river anchor + scroll position. Owns active_landmark_id resolution.
components.reuse_note: Stream's only addition is the scroll behavior binding; the resolver contract is shared. Works for all concepts.

components.role: Inline notice / managed-state banner. Surfaces legal-hold-active, compaction-suspended, import-conflict, air-gap-on, engine-unhealthy, index-degraded.
components.reuse_note: Shared banner grammar; severity + action CTA + dismiss/acknowledge policy reused unchanged.

components.role: River shell hosting scrolling landmark content + persistent left CategoryNavigation. Owns layout, panel restore, and lazy hydration gating.
components.reuse_note: Identical shell across concepts; Stream's variant only changes the scrollspy driver. No C4-specific shell.

components.role: Universal search over settings metadata (without eagerly hydrating all managers). Result select routes through SettingsDestination.
components.reuse_note: Shared; search indexes metadata so Storage/Containers/Git/Web managers are searchable without full hydration.

components.role: Left category/subcategory tree. Selecting a category sets active_landmark_id and scrolls the river.
components.reuse_note: Shared; C4 categories (Storage/Backup/Lifecycle/History/Artifacts/SourceControl/GitHubActions/Containers/Web/SearchIndex/Cleanup/Server) are just more tree nodes.

components.role: Scroll-linked active-landmark highlight. Both drives and reflects scroll position via active_landmark_id. Bidirectional with CategoryNavigation.
components.reuse_note: Stream's signature interaction; implemented once and portable. The scrollspy algorithm is renderer-agnostic (Skia/FemtoVG/software).

components.role: Ordinary setting row grammar: label/value/help/scope/availability. Renders the action_setting_status variant (action button / toggle / badge / manager card).
components.reuse_note: Shared row grammar; C4 adds the action/status/manager variants but reuses the same row shell, focus/keyboard contract, and ValueSourceBadge slot.

components.role: Inherited/managed/default/custom disclosure. The ONLY inheritance disclosure surface.
components.reuse_note: Critical for Stream: Copy Settings From does NOT add a new badge. After a one-time copy, affected rows read 'custom', never 'inherited'. Managed/legal-hold rows read 'managed'.

components.role: Manager container: header + HealthSummary + ResourceList + ResourceDetail + SetupFlowLauncher hook. Lazy hydration boundary.
components.reuse_note: Every C4 manager is a ManagerShell instance. No bespoke manager frame.

components.role: Virtualized list of resources with windowed delegates. Backed by a model proxy (not direct view mutation).
components.reuse_note: Shared virtualized list; Stream requires this for large artifact/history/image/run datasets to avoid jank.

components.role: Per-resource summary card (status + key fields + quick actions + ReceiptLink slot).
components.reuse_note: Shared card grammar; the deferred Server region reuses ResourceCard for human-language host/client cards.

components.role: Per-resource detail pane: full fields + identity refs + open/reveal/export/cleanup actions + lineage.
components.reuse_note: Shared; identity refs (artifact_id/run_id/attempt_id/receipt_id) resolve canonically before layout.

components.role: Manager readiness/health summary: aggregate status + per-item health + degraded reasons + fix-It links.
components.reuse_note: Shared; C4 capability probes (docker/kubectl/git/web) reuse HealthSummary + the shared tool lifecycle.

components.role: Composite storage summary: pressure + legal-hold + quarantine + compaction + retention + last-backup. Composes HealthSummary + Storage-specific badges.
components.reuse_note: Stream-specific composite, but built FROM shared HealthSummary + SettingsNotice. The composition is portable to other concepts that need a multi-signal health summary.

components.role: Runtime artifact row: type/location/version/retention/receipts/redaction + open/reveal/export/cleanup. PM-owned vs provider-native identity badge.
components.reuse_note: Identity-based open first (artifact_id); path reveal is fallback. Reuses ResourceList row contract but adds identity/redaction semantics specific to runtime artifacts.

components.role: Truthful phase/progress/wait surface for long ops. Model-driven (ProgressModel); view never invents phase text or fake liveness.
components.reuse_note: Shared across ALL Stream ops. Lock-wait is a visible phase. CancellationToken honored (e.g., index rebuild on disable).

components.role: Link to durable receipt. Renders receipt_ref, opens receipt detail, carries source disclosure.
components.reuse_note: Every irreversible or receipt-bearing C4 action carries a ReceiptLink. Shared component; receipt retention class (durable/bounded/discardable) is a storage concern, not a view concern.

components.role: Launches a bounded setup flow when a selected capability requires it (engine missing, registry unauth, forge unconnected, SSH source unset).
components.reuse_note: Shared; Stream reuses it for every capability that needs first-run setup. WSL setup shown ONLY when a selected capability requires it (WSL Off is healthy).

families_not_exercised_here.note: These DRY roles exist in the broader candidate list but belong to sibling-owned families. Stream does not exercise them directly; they are listed to prove Stream is not silently dropping them.
roles: AvailabilityReason (consumed by SettingRow/HealthSummary; Stream reuses it for unavailable rows but does not own it)
RequestedEffectiveInspector (core provider concern; Stream reuses for requested/effective model disclosure only)
SecretField/SecretReference (sibling-owned; Stream's web proxy-credentials / registry auth reference it but do not render the editor)
ProviderFamilyCard / AccountConnectionRow / InstallationCard / ModelRow / CapabilityEvidence / UsagePlanSummary (core provider family; Stream demonstrates the manager but the cards are core-owned)

assertion: Every C4-owned flow in Stream is composed from the 18 shared DRY roles above. No bespoke C4-only shell/row/health/observable/receipt component is introduced. StorageHealth is the only Stream-specific composite, and it is built from shared HealthSummary + SettingsNotice.
